title: authz bundle v2
description: Served at GET {AUTHZ_URL}/authz/v2/bundle (and GetBundle). Everything a component needs to decide locally. Additive only within authz/2: consumers ignore unknown members and unknown capability names. Meaning of each member: EVALUATION.md.

contract.description: authz/2.<minor>. A consumer refuses a bundle without this member or with another major, logs at ERROR and keeps serving 503 AUTHZ_NOT_READY until a valid bundle arrives.

member.description: Informative: which member produced the bundle. Never used in a decision.

roles.description: Role code to the permission keys it grants (page, action and field keys alike).

grants.description: Role code to its data-scope assignment and validity window. A role absent here has no levels, no values and no window.

profiles.description: Ceiling profile code to the profile. Referenced by a token's ceil[] claim. Capability delegation.

delegations.description: Active on_behalf delegations, and act_as delegations a member chooses to list. Capability delegation.

stale_since.description: sub to a unix second: a token for that sub issued before stale_since - 5 is stale (401 TOKEN_STALE). Bounded list; entries older than the longest access-token lifetime may be dropped.

revoked_grants.description: Delegation grant id (the dg claim) to the unix second it was revoked. A token whose dg is listed is stale.

catalog_digest.description: Digest of the catalogue the member holds (GetCatalog): sha256 over the RFC 8785 canonical JSON of the catalog object.

revision.description: Monotonic int64 as a decimal string, the consistency token of the member.

list_objects.description: Present when ListObjects answers; absent or false otherwise.

levels.description: Permission key to its level for this role.

default_level.description: Level for keys of this role without an entry in levels. Absent: own.

values.description: Dimension to the values this role holds for every key it grants. org values are department subtrees (paths); * means all and is only ever granted explicitly.

from_ts.description: Inclusive start, unix seconds. Absent: always started.

until.description: Exclusive end, unix seconds. At or after it the role contributes nothing. Absent: no end.

fields.description: Field keys the profile lets through (field keys may also be listed in keys).

relations.description: Relations a share or relation tuple may count through under this ceiling.

to.description: The delegate's sub (on_behalf) or the acting party's sub (act_as).
